messages:
anya: Heads-up: running the long-tail KV-store regression suite and seeing steady memory growth on long-context workloads (>65k tokens). Repro on local perf rig with commit a1b2c3d. My rough numbers: baseline (master@a1b2c3d) ~3.2GB after 30m, new-change ~7.1GB, linear growth. :eyes:

sam: ugh. which test exactly? is this the synthetic concat-longcontext suite or the iterator-interleave one?

anya: synthetic longtail (concat-longcontext). Command: `./bench/run_kv_longtail.sh --iters 200 --context 70000`. Attaching the trimmed log below.

anya: ```
[2026-03-16 11:02:12] iter=0 mem=420MB
[2026-03-16 11:12:12] iter=50 mem=1.6GB
[2026-03-16 11:22:12] iter=100 mem=3.2GB
[2026-03-16 11:32:12] iter=150 mem=5.0GB
[2026-03-16 11:42:12] iter=200 mem=7.1GB
```

carlos: can you also run with `KV_REUSE=0` env? I want to see if reuse path is leaking or eviction.

anya: ran that, with `KV_REUSE=0` it caps ~3.3GB stable. So reuse path looks suspicious.

mira: FYI perf-bot flagged a small regression in KV allocation patterns in that commit (a1b2c3d). It adjusted the slab allocator fast-path to avoid copies, maybe freelist handling got changed.

perf-bot: Automated check: Regression detected in `kv_reuse` heuristics. Metric: heap_growth_rate increased 2.2x in concat-longcontext. See perf dashboard: https://perf.redwood.internal/runs/1769/overview

sam: good catch. can we get a flamegraph? `perf record` or `heaptrack` output would help. Also add a minimal reproducer to reg-suite with `KV_REUSE=1/0` toggles so CI can catch it.

anya: attaching quick flamegraph link (public gist): https://gist.github.com/anya/kv-reuse-flamegraph. Main hotspot in `kv_reuse::try_merge_fragment` and `freelist::pop_head` calls.

carlos: sounds like fragmentation + failed coalescing. If reuse tries to keep many small fragments for speed, it may prevent page reclaim and cause memory to grow when contexts are long. We should add a test that stresses interleaved evictions to force coalesce and verify memory bound.

mira: I'll open a PR with: 1) unit test that creates many small fragments and forces eviction, 2) bench variant for long contexts with reuse toggles, 3) temporary metric to count fragment_count and avg_fragment_size.

mira: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4523 (wip)

anya: thanks. infra-bot also suggests a bisect: try rolling back the allocator change in a branch to confirm.

infra-bot: Suggested bisect candidate commits: a1b2c3d (allocator fast-path), 9f8e7d6c (kv reuse heuristic tweak). Start with a1b2c3d revert.

sam: action items:
- mira: add regression test + metrics (ETA EOD)
- anya: capture heaptrack dump and attach (ETA today)
- carlos: prototyping coalesce fix and perf test (ETA tomorrow)
- I'll add CI gate to run concat-longcontext on PRs touching kv reuse/allocator

anya: noted. will drop heaptrack and raw logs in the PR. Thanks all :thumbsup:
